_comment: CodeAudit Agent local advisory database (Phase 4). Copy to advisories.json in this directory and populate with backend/scripts/refresh_advisories.py (OSV.dev), or write your own entries in this schema. Dependency vulnerability matching uses ONLY this file: a dependency with no matching advisory here is never reported as vulnerable (DEP-003 informational finding instead). Never invent entries: copy id/summary/published/affected_spec from the real advisory source.

advisories.summary: Example advisory shape: replace with the real advisory summary.
npm advisory shape: compound comparators '>=a <b' are supported; ^ ~ >= <= > < and exact pins too.
